generated_queries.text: Lesson objective: Students will review and describe patterns observed in the sky using evidence from notes, share information orally with partners, and record observations in their Sky notebook.
Students learn / practice: describe a pattern observed in the sky using evidence from notes
Students learn / practice: share information about a selected pattern orally with a partner using notes
Students learn / practice: use a structured partner discussion protocol (Back-to-Back and Face-to-Face) to share and
Students learn / practice: record observations from videos/images of the sky in a notebook
Students learn / practice: use prepositions and adjectives to describe observations in writing
Students learn / practice: participate in reciting a poem with gestures or hand motions
Students learn / practice: use sentence frames to support oral expression
Students learn / practice: engage in partner talk to recall and share information
Required student action — recognition_identification: identify patterns and evidence from notes and images
Required student action — oral_production: orally share information about patterns and participate in poem recitation
Required student action — written_production: write observations and descriptions in the Sky notebook
Required student action — matching_sorting_sequencing: sequence and select notes sheets for sharing
Vocabulary targets (acquire / apply / clarify meaning): evidence (L)
Discussion Prompt: explain and clarify information about patterns orally
Writing Task: write observations and descriptions in the Sky notebook

Reading Task: respond to questions about patterns and evidence from notes and images, including turn and talk and partner sharing activities, and answer prompts about observations and patterns in the sky, using evidence from notes and images to support responses, and participate in total participation techniques to recall vocabulary and concepts related to
Discussion Prompt: Invite a student volunteer to lead the class in reciting the poem and doing any accompanying hand motions or gestures. Repeat as time allows with other student volunteers.
